description: This line plot illustrates the Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR@10) performance across different DPR (Dense Passage Retrieval) inference strategies as a function of the number of queries used during inference, denoted as S. The x-axis, labeled “Number of queries used during inference (S),” is linearly scaled from 2 to 10, with tick marks appearing at integer intervals. The y-axis, labeled “MRR@10,” is also linearly scaled, ranging from 33.0 to 36.5, with tick marks at 0.5 intervals. The plot contains six distinct lines, each representing a different DPR configuration: a black solid line for “DPR w/o query,” a gold solid line for “DPR w/ gold,” a green solid line with circular markers for “DPR w/ bottom-1,” a purple dashed line with circular markers for “DPR w/ random,” a blue dashed line with circular markers for “DPR w/ random,” and a red dashed line with circular markers for “DPR w/ curriculum.” The “DPR w/o query” line remains constant at 34.0 across the entire range. The “DPR w/ gold” line starts at 33.0 when S=2 and increases to 35.0 at S=10. The “DPR w/ bottom-1” line starts at 34.5 when S=2, rises sharply to 36.5 at S=10, and exhibits a slight dip around S=6. The “DPR w/ random” line begins at 34.5 when S=2, remains relatively flat at approximately 35.0, and ends at 34.5 when S=10. The “DPR w/ curriculum” line begins at 35.2 when S=2, remains relatively flat at approximately 35.7, and ends at 35.7 when S=10. The “DPR w/ bottom-1” line consistently outperforms all other configurations across the entire range of S values.
